rv.q: Griffin Theatre’s world premiere of this one-act Christmas musical is a high-end Hallmark movie, and I mean that as a compliment. I’ll preface it with the “content warning” that you must be looking for a heartwarming holiday story, but if that’s your jam, The House Without a Christmas Tree is elevating the art form this season.
Darrelyn Marx as Grandma Mills is the beating heart of the show.
Charm abounds in The House without a Christmas Tree. Discomfort, surprise and nuance, however, are in short supply.

cn.t: Griffin Theatre's world premiere musical adaptation charms with its heartwarming holiday story and nostalgic appeal, elevating the Hallmark-style Christmas tale into an engaging theatrical experience.
